/* Formatted on 9/17/2026 9:59:15 PM (QP5 v5.362) */
  SELECT RAWTOHEX (m.MERCHANT_ID)           AS MERCHANT_ID,
         m.CIF,
         m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
         m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,
         m.BRANCH_CODE,
         m.BRANCH_NAME,
         COUNT (DISTINCT t.TERMINAL_ID)     AS TERMINAL_COUNT
    FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
         LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r
             ON r.MERCHANT_ID = m.MERCHANT_ID AND NVL (r.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
         LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL t
             ON t.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID AND NVL (t.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
   WHERE NVL (m.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
GROUP BY m.MERCHANT_ID,
         m.CIF,
         m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
         m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,
         m.BRANCH_CODE,
         m.BRANCH_NAME,
         m.CREATED_AT
ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC
